<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="pl" class="h-full">

<head>

<meta charset="UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>Planer Layoutu Stoiska Targowego</title>

<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">

<style>

body {

font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;

touch-action: none;

}

.canvas-container {

background-image: radial-gradient(#cbd5e1 1px, transparent 1px);

background-size: 20px 20px;

}

::-webkit-scrollbar {

width: 6px;

height: 6px;

}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {

background: #f1f5f9;

}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {

background: #94a3b8;

border-radius: 4px;

}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {

background: #64748b;

}

/* Custom styling for rotated grid viewport */

.compass-ring {

transition: transform 0.1s ease-out;

}

</style>

</head>

<body class="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden flex flex-col select-none">

 

<header class="bg-slate-900 text-white px-4 py-2.5 flex justify-between items-center shadow-md z-30 shrink-0">

<div class="flex items-center space-x-3">

<button onclick="toggleMobileSidebar()" class="md:hidden bg-slate-800 p-2 rounded text-slate-200 hover:text-white">

<i class="fa-solid fa-bars text-lg"></i>

</button>

<div class="bg-blue-600 p-2 rounded-lg text-white">

<i class="fa-solid fa-compass-drafting text-xl"></i>

</div>

<div>

<h1 class="font-bold text-base md:text-lg leading-tight">Planer Layoutu Stoiska</h1>

<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 hidden sm:block">Siatka podstawowa: 1 metr = 100 px | Obrót 360°</p>

</div>

</div>

 

<div class="flex items-center space-x-2">

<button onclick="document.getElementById('json-input').click()" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs md:text-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition flex items-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-folder-open"></i> <span class="hidden sm:inline">Otwórz JSON</span>

</button>

<input type="file" id="json-input" class="hidden" accept=".json" onchange="loadProjectJSON(event)">

 

<button onclick="saveProjectJSON()" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs md:text-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition flex items-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk"></i> <span class="hidden sm:inline">Zapisz JSON</span>

</button>

 

<button onclick="exportToPNG()" class="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs md:text-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow font-medium transition flex items-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-file-image"></i> <span>Eksportuj PNG</span>

</button>

</div>

</header>

 

<div class="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden relative">

 

<!-- Overlay dla urządzeń mobilnych -->

<div id="mobile-overlay" onclick="toggleMobileSidebar()" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-20 hidden md:hidden"></div>

 

<!-- Lewy panel: Biblioteka elementów i tło -->

<aside id="left-sidebar" class="w-80 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 flex flex-col shrink-0 z-30 shadow-lg transition-transform duration-300 absolute md:relative h-full -translate-x-full md:translate-x-0 overflow-y-auto">

 

<div class="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 flex justify-between items-center">

<h2 class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group text-blue-600"></i> Dodaj do projektu

</h2>

<button onclick="toggleMobileSidebar()" class="md:hidden text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600">

<i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-lg"></i>

</button>

</div>

 

<!-- Sekcja: Biblioteka gotowych mebli -->

<div class="p-4 border-b border-slate-200">

<h3 class="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Katalog Elementów</h3>

<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5" id="preset-library">

<!-- Dynamicznie generowane elementy -->

</div>

</div>

 

<!-- Sekcja: Dodawanie własnego elementu -->

<div class="p-4 border-b border-slate-200">

<h3 class="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Niestandardowy Element</h3>

<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-2">

<div>

<label class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600">Szerokość (m)</label>

<input type="number" id="custom-w" value="1.0" step="0.05" min="0.1" class="w-full text-xs px-2 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none">

</div>

<div>

<label class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600">Wysokość/Dł. (m)</label>

<input type="number" id="custom-h" value="1.0" step="0.05" min="0.1" class="w-full text-xs px-2 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none">

</div>

</div>

<div class="mb-3">

<label class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600">Etykieta</label>

<input type="text" id="custom-name" value="Element Stoiska" class="w-full text-xs px-2 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none">

</div>

<button onclick="addCustomItem()" class="w-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs py-2 rounded font-medium transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i> Dodaj Własny Obiekt

</button>

</div>

 

<!-- Sekcja: Ustawienia tła / Mapy -->

<div class="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">

<h3 class="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">

<span><i class="fa-solid fa-image text-slate-600"></i> Tło / Mapa przestrzeni</span>

</h3>

 

<div class="space-y-3">

<div>

<label class="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Wgraj zdjęcie lub rzut stoiska</label>

<input type="file" id="bg-upload" accept="image/*" onchange="handleBgUpload(event)" class="w-full text-xs text-slate-500 file:mr-2 file:py-1 file:px-3 file:rounded file:border-0 file:text-xs file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-50 file:text-blue-700 hover:file:bg-blue-100 cursor-pointer">

</div>

 

<div id="bg-controls" class="space-y-2 hidden pt-2 border-t border-slate-200">

<div>

<div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-600 mb-1">

<span>Przezroczystość tła</span>

<span id="bg-opacity-val">50%</span>

</div>

<input type="range" id="bg-opacity" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="0.5" oninput="updateBgSettings()" class="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer">

</div>

 

<div>

<div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-600 mb-1">

<span>Skala tła</span>

<span id="bg-scale-val">100%</span>

</div>

<input type="range" id="bg-scale" min="0.2" max="3" step="0.05" value="1" oninput="updateBgSettings()" class="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer">

</div>

 

<button onclick="removeBackground()" class="w-full bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 text-xs py-1.5 rounded transition font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-1">

<i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i> Usuń Tło

</button>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</aside>

 

<main class="flex-1 relative bg-slate-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">

 

<!-- Pasek Narzędziowy Przestrzeni Roboczej -->

<div class="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3 z-10 shadow-sm">

 

<!-- Przyciąganie do siatki -->

<div class="flex items-center space-x-3">

<label class="inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer">

<input type="checkbox" id="snap-toggle" checked class="sr-only peer">

<div class="relative w-9 h-5 bg-slate-300 peer-focus:outline-none rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-[2px] after:left-[2px] after:bg-white after:border-slate-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-4 after:w-4 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-blue-600"></div>

<span class="ml-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Przyciągaj</span>

</label>

 

<select id="snap-step" class="text-xs border border-slate-300 rounded px-2 py-1 bg-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">

<option value="0.1">co 0.1m (10cm)</option>

<option value="0.25">co 0.25m (25cm)</option>

<option value="0.5" selected>co 0.5m (50cm)</option>

<option value="1.0">co 1.0m (1m)</option>

</select>

</div>

 

<!-- Kontroler Obracania Całej Siatki 360° -->

<div class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-1 shadow-inner">

<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-600 text-xs font-bold">

<i class="fa-solid fa-rotate text-sm"></i>

<span class="hidden sm:inline">Obrót Siatki:</span>

</div>

<input type="range" id="grid-rotation-slider" min="0" max="360" value="0" step="1" oninput="setGridRotation(this.value)" class="w-24 sm:w-32 h-1.5 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-blue-600">

<div class="flex items-center gap-1">

<input type="number" id="grid-rotation-num" min="0" max="360" value="0" onchange="setGridRotation(this.value)" class="w-12 text-center text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded py-0.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500">

<span class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">°</span>

</div>

<div class="flex gap-1 border-l border-slate-300 pl-2">

<button onclick="setGridRotation(0)" class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600 rounded font-semibold text-slate-600" title="Kąt 0°">0°</button>

<button onclick="setGridRotation(90)" class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600 rounded font-semibold text-slate-600" title="Kąt 90°">90°</button>

<button onclick="setGridRotation(180)" class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600 rounded font-semibold text-slate-600" title="Kąt 180°">180°</button>

<button onclick="setGridRotation(270)" class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600 rounded font-semibold text-slate-600" title="Kąt 270°">270°</button>

</div>

</div>

 

<!-- Kontrolki Przybliżenia (Zoom) -->

<div class="flex items-center space-x-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg p-1 border border-slate-300">

<button onclick="adjustZoom(-0.1)" class="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-white rounded transition" title="Pomniejsz">

<i class="fa-solid fa-minus text-xs"></i>

</button>

<span id="zoom-level" class="text-xs font-mono px-2 font-bold text-slate-700">100%</span>

<button onclick="adjustZoom(0.1)" class="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-white rounded transition" title="Powiększ">

<i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-xs"></i>

</button>

<button onclick="resetZoom()" class="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-white rounded transition border-l border-slate-300 ml-1" title="Resetuj przybliżenie">

<i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-left text-xs"></i>

</button>

</div>

</div>

 

<div id="viewport" class="flex-1 relative overflow-auto cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing">

 

<!-- Główny kontener planszy ze wspólną transformacją obrotu i skali -->

<div id="canvas-wrapper" class="relative transition-transform duration-75 min-w-[3000px] min-h-[3000px]" style="transform-origin: 1500px 1500px;">

 

<!-- Warstwa Siatki Podstawowej (1 metr = 100px) -->

<div id="grid-bg" class="absolute inset-0 bg-white"

style="background-size: 100px 100px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.7) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.7) 1px, transparent 1px);">

</div>

 

<!-- Podsiatka 10cm -->

<div id="subgrid-bg" class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none"

style="background-size: 10px 10px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.5) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.5) 1px, transparent 1px);">

</div>

 

<!-- Osie środkowe planszy dla ułatwienia orientacji -->

<div class="absolute left-0 top-[1500px] right-0 h-0.5 bg-blue-300/50 pointer-events-none"></div>

<div class="absolute top-0 left-[1500px] bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-blue-300/50 pointer-events-none"></div>

 

<!-- Warstwa obrazu tła / rzutu stoiska -->

<div id="bg-layer" class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none origin-center flex items-center justify-center">

<img id="bg-image" src="" class="hidden pointer-events-none max-w-none">

</div>

 

<!-- Warstwa Obiektów Katalogowych -->

<div id="objects-layer" class="absolute inset-0"></div>

 

</div>

 

<!-- Interaktywny Kompas Orientacji Siatki -->

<div class="fixed bottom-4 right-4 bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur text-white text-xs p-3 rounded-2xl shadow-xl pointer-events-none z-20 flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 border border-slate-700">

<div class="relative w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-slate-600 rounded-full bg-slate-800">

<div id="compass-rose" class="compass-ring absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">

<span class="absolute top-0.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold text-red-400">N</span>

<span class="absolute right-1 text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400">E</span>

<span class="absolute bottom-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400">S</span>

<span class="absolute left-1 text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400">W</span>

<i class="fa-solid fa-location-arrow text-blue-400 text-lg transform -rotate-45"></i>

</div>

</div>

<span id="compass-deg" class="font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-blue-300">0°</span>

</div>

 

<!-- Wskaźnik wymiarowania metrycznego -->

<div class="fixed bottom-4 left-4 bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur text-white text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg pointer-events-none z-20 flex items-center gap-2.5 border border-slate-700">

<span class="w-8 h-0.5 bg-blue-400 inline-block rounded-full"></span>

<span class="font-medium text-slate-200">Siatka: 1 metr (100 px)</span>

</div>

</div>

</main>

 

<!-- Prawy panel: Właściwości zaznaczonego obiektu -->

<aside id="properties-panel" class="w-72 bg-white border-l border-slate-200 p-4 flex flex-col shrink-0 z-20 shadow-lg hidden">

<div class="flex justify-between items-center pb-3 mb-4 border-b border-slate-200">

<h2 class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-sliders text-blue-600"></i> Właściwości

</h2>

<button onclick="deselectAll()" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600">

<i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>

</button>

</div>

 

<div class="space-y-4 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">

<div>

<label class="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Nazwa / Etykieta</label>

<input type="text" id="prop-label" oninput="updateSelectedObject()" class="w-full text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none">

</div>

 

<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">

<div>

<label class="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Szerokość (m)</label>

<input type="number" id="prop-width" step="0.05" min="0.1" oninput="updateSelectedObject()" class="w-full text-xs px-2 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded outline-none">

</div>

<div>

<label class="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Długość (m)</label>

<input type="number" id="prop-height" step="0.05" min="0.1" oninput="updateSelectedObject()" class="w-full text-xs px-2 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded outline-none">

</div>

</div>

 

<div>

<div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">

<span>Obrót obiektu</span>

<span id="prop-rotation-val">0°</span>

</div>

<input type="range" id="prop-rotation" min="0" max="360" value="0" step="5" oninput="updateSelectedObject()" class="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer">

<div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1 mt-2">

<button onclick="rotateSelected(0)" class="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 py-1 rounded">0°</button>

<button onclick="rotateSelected(90)" class="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 py-1 rounded">90°</button>

<button onclick="rotateSelected(180)" class="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 py-1 rounded">180°</button>

<button onclick="rotateSelected(270)" class="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 py-1 rounded">270°</button>

</div>

</div>

 

<div>

<label class="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Kolor wypełnienia</label>

<div class="flex items-center gap-2">

<input type="color" id="prop-color" oninput="updateSelectedObject()" class="w-8 h-8 rounded border border-slate-300 cursor-pointer">

<span id="prop-color-hex" class="text-xs font-mono uppercase text-slate-500">#000000</span>

</div>

</div>

 

<div>

<label class="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 mb-1">Kolejność warstw</label>

<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">

<button onclick="changeZIndex(1)" class="bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-xs py-1.5 rounded font-medium text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">

<i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i> Na wierzch

</button>

<button onclick="changeZIndex(-1)" class="bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-xs py-1.5 rounded font-medium text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">

<i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i> Pod spód

</button>

</div>

</div>

 

<div class="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 space-y-2">

<button onclick="duplicateSelected()" class="w-full bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-xs py-2 rounded font-medium transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-copy"></i> Duplikuj Element

</button>

<button onclick="deleteSelected()" class="w-full bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 text-xs py-2 rounded font-medium transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2">

<i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i> Usuń Element

</button>

</div>

</div>

</aside>

</div>

 

<script>

// --- STAŁE I STAN APLIKACJI ---

const SCALE = 100; // 1 metr = 100 pikseli

const CANVAS_SIZE = 3000; // Rozmiar planszy 3000x3000px

const CENTER_POINT = CANVAS_SIZE / 2; // Środek rotacji (1500, 1500)

 

let currentZoom = 1;

let gridRotation = 0; // Obrót siatki w stopniach (0 - 360)

let objects = [];

let selectedId = null;

 

let bgConfig = {

url: '',

opacity: 0.5,

scale: 1

};

 

// Baza mebli i elementów stoiska z katalogu

const PRESETS = [

{ type: 'kallax_1x4', name: 'Kallax 1x4', w: 0.42, h: 0.39, color: '#475569', icon: 'fa-cubes' },

{ type: 'kallax_2x4', name: 'Kallax 2x4', w: 0.77, h: 0.39, color: '#475569', icon: 'fa-cubes' },

{ type: 'kallax_3x4', name: 'Kallax 3x4', w: 1.12, h: 0.39, color: '#475569', icon: 'fa-cubes' },

{ type: 'kallax_4x4', name: 'Kallax 4x4', w: 1.47, h: 0.39, color: '#475569', icon: 'fa-cubes' },

{ type: 'billie', name: 'Regał Billie', w: 0.80, h: 0.20, color: '#64748b', icon: 'fa-book-open' },

{ type: 'trolley', name: 'Wózek jezdny', w: 0.92, h: 0.58, color: '#d97706', icon: 'fa-truck-ramp-box' },

{ type: 'rot_silver', name: 'Ekspozytor obrotowy (srebrny)', w: 0.40, h: 0.40, color: '#94a3b8', icon: 'fa-arrows-spin' },

{ type: 'rot_black', name: 'Ekspozytor obrotowy (czarny)', w: 0.45, h: 0.45, color: '#334155', icon: 'fa-arrows-spin' },

{ type: 'disp_white', name: 'Ekspozytor biały', w: 0.845, h: 0.46, color: '#e2e8f0', icon: 'fa-box-open' },

{ type: 'table_large', name: 'Stół duży', w: 1.80, h: 0.74, color: '#1e293b', icon: 'fa-table' },

{ type: 'table_small', name: 'Stół mały', w: 1.50, h: 0.73, color: '#334155', icon: 'fa-table' },

{ type: 'cash_desk', name: 'Kasa stolik mały', w: 0.70, h: 0.50, color: '#059669', icon: 'fa-cash-register' },

{ type: 'chair', name: 'Krzesło / Hoker', w: 0.45, h: 0.45, color: '#475569', icon: 'fa-chair' },

{ type: 'table_round', name: 'Stolik okrągły', w: 0.80, h: 0.80, color: '#d97706', icon: 'fa-circle' },

{ type: 'rollup', name: 'Roll-up banner', w: 0.85, h: 0.30, color: '#10b981', icon: 'fa-scroll' }

];

 

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initApp);

if (document.readyState === 'interactive' || document.readyState === 'complete') {

initApp();

}

 

function initApp() {

if (window.appInitialized) return;

window.appInitialized = true;

 

renderPresetLibrary();

initInteractions();

applyCanvasTransform();

 

// Przykładowy układ początkowy wokół środka planszy

if (objects.length === 0) {

addObject({ name: 'Stół duży', x: 1410, y: 1463, w: 1.80, h: 0.74, color: '#1e293b' });

addObject({ name: 'Krzesło / Hoker', x: 1477, y: 1390, w: 0.45, h: 0.45, color: '#475569' });

addObject({ name: 'Roll-up banner', x: 1300, y: 1390, w: 0.85, h: 0.30, color: '#10b981' });

}

 

// Wyśrodkowanie widoku

setTimeout(centerViewport, 100);

}

 

function centerViewport() {

const viewport = document.getElementById('viewport');

const wrapper = document.getElementById('canvas-wrapper');

if (viewport && wrapper) {

viewport.scrollLeft = (CANVAS_SIZE * currentZoom - viewport.clientWidth) / 2;

viewport.scrollTop = (CANVAS_SIZE * currentZoom - viewport.clientHeight) / 2;

}

}

 

function toggleMobileSidebar() {

const sidebar = document.getElementById('left-sidebar');

const overlay = document.getElementById('mobile-overlay');

sidebar.classList.toggle('-translate-x-full');

overlay.classList.toggle('hidden');

}

 

function renderPresetLibrary() {

const container = document.getElementById('preset-library');

if (!container) return;

container.innerHTML = PRESETS.map((p, idx) => `

<button onclick="addPresetItem(${idx})" class="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 hover:border-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-50/50 rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center transition group">

<i class="fa-solid ${p.icon} text-slate-600 group-hover:text-blue-600 text-lg mb-1"></i>

<span class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 leading-tight">${p.name}</span>

<span class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">${p.w}m x ${p.h}m</span>

</button>

`).join('');

}

 

function setGridRotation(deg) {

let angle = parseFloat(deg);

if (isNaN(angle)) angle = 0;

angle = ((angle % 360) + 360) % 360; // Normalizacja do przedziału 0-360°

 

gridRotation = angle;

 

// Aktualizacja kontrolek UI

document.getElementById('grid-rotation-slider').value = Math.round(gridRotation);

document.getElementById('grid-rotation-num').value = Math.round(gridRotation);

document.getElementById('compass-deg').textContent = `${Math.round(gridRotation)}°`;

 

// Obrót tarczy kompasu

const compass = document.getElementById('compass-rose');

if (compass) {

compass.style.transform = `rotate(${gridRotation}deg)`;

}

 

applyCanvasTransform();

}

 

function applyCanvasTransform() {

const wrapper = document.getElementById('canvas-wrapper');

if (wrapper) {

wrapper.style.transform = `scale(${currentZoom}) rotate(${gridRotation}deg)`;

}

document.getElementById('zoom-level').textContent = `${Math.round(currentZoom * 100)}%`;

}

 

// Konwersja współrzędnych ekranu do układu współrzędnych obróconej siatki

function screenToCanvasCoords(clientX, clientY) {

const wrapper = document.getElementById('canvas-wrapper');

const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();

 

// Środek planszy na ekranie (punkt obrotu)

const screenCenterX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;

const screenCenterY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;

 

// Wektor przesunięcia kursora od środka planszy w pikselach ekranu

const dxScreen = clientX - screenCenterX;

const dyScreen = clientY - screenCenterY;

 

// Odskalowanie

const dxUnscaled = dxScreen / currentZoom;

const dyUnscaled = dyScreen / currentZoom;

 

// Odskręcenie o kąt obrotu siatki (-gridRotation w radianach)

const rad = (-gridRotation * Math.PI) / 180;

const dxLocal = dxUnscaled * Math.cos(rad) - dyUnscaled * Math.sin(rad);

const dyLocal = dxUnscaled * Math.sin(rad) + dyUnscaled * Math.cos(rad);

 

// Przeliczenie do lokalnego układu planszy (lewy górny róg = 0,0)

return {

x: CENTER_POINT + dxLocal,

y: CENTER_POINT + dyLocal

};

}

 

function initInteractions() {

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

if (['INPUT', 'SELECT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(e.target.tagName)) return;

 

if (e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') {

deleteSelected();

} else if (e.key === 'Escape') {

deselectAll();

} else if (selectedId) {

const obj = objects.find(o => o.id === selectedId);

if (!obj) return;

const step = e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1;

if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { obj.x -= step; e.preventDefault(); }

if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { obj.x += step; e.preventDefault(); }

if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { obj.y -= step; e.preventDefault(); }

if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { obj.y += step; e.preventDefault(); }

renderObjectDOM(obj);

syncInspector();

}

});

 

const viewport = document.getElementById('viewport');

let isPanning = false;

let startPan = { x: 0, y: 0 };

let scrollStart = { left: 0, top: 0 };

 

viewport.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {

if (e.target.id === 'viewport' || e.target.id === 'grid-bg' || e.target.id === 'subgrid-bg' || e.target.id === 'canvas-wrapper') {

isPanning = true;

startPan = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };

scrollStart = { left: viewport.scrollLeft, top: viewport.scrollTop };

}

});

 

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {

if (!isPanning) return;

const dx = e.clientX - startPan.x;

const dy = e.clientY - startPan.y;

viewport.scrollLeft = scrollStart.left - dx;

viewport.scrollTop = scrollStart.top - dy;

});

 

window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {

isPanning = false;

});

 

viewport.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {

if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {

e.preventDefault();

adjustZoom(e.deltaY < 0 ? 0.1 : -0.1);

}

}, { passive: false });

}

 

function addObject(data) {

const id = 'obj_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4);

const newObj = {

id: id,

name: data.name || 'Nowy Obiekt',

x: data.x !== undefined ? data.x : CENTER_POINT - 50,

y: data.y !== undefined ? data.y : CENTER_POINT - 50,

w: data.w || 1.0,

h: data.h || 1.0,

rotation: data.rotation || 0,

color: data.color || '#3b82f6',

zIndex: objects.length + 1

};

objects.push(newObj);

renderObjectDOM(newObj);

selectObject(id);

}

 

function addPresetItem(idx) {

const p = PRESETS[idx];

addObject({

name: p.name,

w: p.w,

h: p.h,

color: p.color

});

if (window.innerWidth < 768) {

toggleMobileSidebar();

}

}

 

function addCustomItem() {

const w = parseFloat(document.getElementById('custom-w').value) || 1.0;

const h = parseFloat(document.getElementById('custom-h').value) || 1.0;

const name = document.getElementById('custom-name').value || 'Własny Element';

addObject({ name, w, h, color: '#0ea5e9' });

if (window.innerWidth < 768) {

toggleMobileSidebar();

}

}

 

function renderObjectDOM(obj) {

const layer = document.getElementById('objects-layer');

let el = document.getElementById(obj.id);

 

if (!el) {

el = document.createElement('div');

el.id = obj.id;

el.className = 'absolute cursor-move border-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1 rounded transition-shadow';

el.style.touchAction = 'none';

 

el.innerHTML = `

<div class="obj-content flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center pointer-events-none w-full h-full overflow-hidden">

<span class="obj-label font-bold text-xs truncate w-full px-1"></span>

<span class="obj-dims text-[10px] opacity-75"></span>

</div>

`;

 

el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => onPointerDown(e, obj.id));

layer.appendChild(el);

}

 

const pixelW = obj.w * SCALE;

const pixelH = obj.h * SCALE;

 

el.style.width = `${pixelW}px`;

el.style.height = `${pixelH}px`;

el.style.left = `${obj.x}px`;

el.style.top = `${obj.y}px`;

el.style.transform = `rotate(${obj.rotation}deg)`;

el.style.backgroundColor = hexToRgba(obj.color, 0.35);

el.style.borderColor = obj.color;

el.style.zIndex = obj.zIndex;

 

const labelEl = el.querySelector('.obj-label');

const dimsEl = el.querySelector('.obj-dims');

labelEl.textContent = obj.name;

labelEl.style.color = getContrastingColor(obj.color);

dimsEl.textContent = `${obj.w.toFixed(2)}m × ${obj.h.toFixed(2)}m`;

dimsEl.style.color = getContrastingColor(obj.color);

 

if (obj.id === selectedId) {

el.classList.add('ring-4', 'ring-blue-500/50', 'shadow-2xl', 'z-50');

} else {

el.classList.remove('ring-4', 'ring-blue-500/50', 'shadow-2xl', 'z-50');

}

}

 

let isDragging = false;

let dragOffset = { x: 0, y: 0 };

 

function onPointerDown(e, id) {

e.stopPropagation();

selectObject(id);

 

isDragging = true;

const obj = objects.find(o => o.id === id);

 

const localMouse = screenToCanvasCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY);

 

dragOffset.x = localMouse.x - obj.x;

dragOffset.y = localMouse.y - obj.y;

 

window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);

window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);

}

 

function onPointerMove(e) {

if (!isDragging || !selectedId) return;

 

const obj = objects.find(o => o.id === selectedId);

const localMouse = screenToCanvasCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY);

 

let rawX = localMouse.x - dragOffset.x;

let rawY = localMouse.y - dragOffset.y;

 

const snapEnabled = document.getElementById('snap-toggle').checked;

const snapStepMeter = parseFloat(document.getElementById('snap-step').value);

const snapPx = snapStepMeter * SCALE;

 

if (snapEnabled) {

obj.x = Math.round(rawX / snapPx) * snapPx;

obj.y = Math.round(rawY / snapPx) * snapPx;

} else {

obj.x = Math.round(rawX);

obj.y = Math.round(rawY);

}

 

renderObjectDOM(obj);

syncInspector();

}

 

function onPointerUp() {

isDragging = false;

window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);

window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);

}

 

function selectObject(id) {

selectedId = id;

objects.forEach(renderObjectDOM);

 

const panel = document.getElementById('properties-panel');

if (id) {

panel.classList.remove('hidden');

syncInspector();

} else {

panel.classList.add('hidden');

}

}

 

function deselectAll() {

selectObject(null);

}

 

function syncInspector() {

if (!selectedId) return;

const obj = objects.find(o => o.id === selectedId);

if (!obj) return;

 

document.getElementById('prop-label').value = obj.name;

document.getElementById('prop-width').value = obj.w;

document.getElementById('prop-height').value = obj.h;

document.getElementById('prop-rotation').value = obj.rotation;

document.getElementById('prop-rotation-val').textContent = `${obj.rotation}°`;

document.getElementById('prop-color').value = obj.color;

document.getElementById('prop-color-hex').textContent = obj.color;

}

 

function updateSelectedObject() {

if (!selectedId) return;

const obj = objects.find(o => o.id === selectedId);

 

obj.name = document.getElementById('prop-label').value;

obj.w = parseFloat(document.getElementById('prop-width').value) || 0.1;

obj.h = parseFloat(document.getElementById('prop-height').value) || 0.1;

obj.rotation = parseInt(document.getElementById('prop-rotation').value) || 0;

obj.color = document.getElementById('prop-color').value;

 

document.getElementById('prop-rotation-val').textContent = `${obj.rotation}°`;

document.getElementById('prop-color-hex').textContent = obj.color;

 

renderObjectDOM(obj);

}

 

function rotateSelected(deg) {

document.getElementById('prop-rotation').value = deg;

updateSelectedObject();

}

 

function changeZIndex(delta) {

if (!selectedId) return;

const obj = objects.find(o => o.id === selectedId);

obj.zIndex = Math.max(1, obj.zIndex + delta);

renderObjectDOM(obj);

}

 

function duplicateSelected() {

if (!selectedId) return;

const obj = objects.find(o => o.id === selectedId);

addObject({

name: obj.name + ' (Kopia)',

x: obj.x + 30,

y: obj.y + 30,

w: obj.w,

h: obj.h,

rotation: obj.rotation,

color: obj.color

});

}

 

function deleteSelected() {

if (!selectedId) return;

const el = document.getElementById(selectedId);

if (el) el.remove();

objects = objects.filter(o => o.id !== selectedId);

deselectAll();

}

 

function adjustZoom(delta) {

currentZoom = Math.min(Math.max(0.3, currentZoom + delta), 2.5);

applyCanvasTransform();

}

 

function resetZoom() {

currentZoom = 1;

applyCanvasTransform();

}

 

function handleBgUpload(event) {

const file = event.target.files[0];

if (!file) return;

 

const reader = new FileReader();

reader.onload = function(e) {

bgConfig.url = e.target.result;

const img = document.getElementById('bg-image');

img.src = bgConfig.url;

img.classList.remove('hidden');

document.getElementById('bg-controls').classList.remove('hidden');

updateBgSettings();

};

reader.readAsDataURL(file);

}

 

function updateBgSettings() {

const opacity = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bg-opacity').value);

const scale = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bg-scale').value);

 

bgConfig.opacity = opacity;

bgConfig.scale = scale;

 

document.getElementById('bg-opacity-val').textContent = `${Math.round(opacity * 100)}%`;

document.getElementById('bg-scale-val').textContent = `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;

 

const imgLayer = document.getElementById('bg-layer');

imgLayer.style.opacity = opacity;

imgLayer.style.transform = `scale(${scale})`;

}

 

function removeBackground() {

bgConfig.url = '';

const img = document.getElementById('bg-image');

img.src = '';

img.classList.add('hidden');

document.getElementById('bg-controls').classList.add('hidden');

document.getElementById('bg-upload').value = '';

}

 

function saveProjectJSON() {

const projectData = {

version: '1.1',

date: new Date().toISOString(),

gridRotation: gridRotation,

bgConfig: bgConfig,

objects: objects

};

 

const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(projectData, null, 2));

const downloadAnchor = document.createElement('a');

downloadAnchor.setAttribute("href", dataStr);

downloadAnchor.setAttribute("download", `stoisko_layout_${Date.now()}.json`);

document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchor);

downloadAnchor.click();

downloadAnchor.remove();

}

 

function loadProjectJSON(event) {

const file = event.target.files[0];

if (!file) return;

 

const reader = new FileReader();

reader.onload = function(e) {

try {

const data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);

 

document.getElementById('objects-layer').innerHTML = '';

objects = [];

deselectAll();

 

if (data.gridRotation !== undefined) {

setGridRotation(data.gridRotation);

} else {

setGridRotation(0);

}

 

if (data.bgConfig && data.bgConfig.url) {

bgConfig = data.bgConfig;

const img = document.getElementById('bg-image');

img.src = bgConfig.url;

img.classList.remove('hidden');

document.getElementById('bg-controls').classList.remove('hidden');

document.getElementById('bg-opacity').value = bgConfig.opacity || 0.5;

document.getElementById('bg-scale').value = bgConfig.scale || 1;

updateBgSettings();

} else {

removeBackground();

}

 

if (data.objects && Array.isArray(data.objects)) {

data.objects.forEach(objData => {

addObject(objData);

});

}

} catch (err) {

alert('Błąd podczas wczytywania pliku JSON!');

}

};

reader.readAsText(file);

}

 

function exportToPNG() {

deselectAll();

 

if (objects.length === 0) {

alert('Dodaj elementy do projektu przed wyeksportowaniem.');

return;

}

 

// Znalezienie granic zawartości

let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;

objects.forEach(o => {

minX = Math.min(minX, o.x);

minY = Math.min(minY, o.y);

maxX = Math.max(maxX, o.x + o.w * SCALE);

maxY = Math.max(maxY, o.y + o.h * SCALE);

});

 

const padding = 100;

minX = Math.max(0, minX - padding);

minY = Math.max(0, minY - padding);

maxX = Math.min(CANVAS_SIZE, maxX + padding);

maxY = Math.min(CANVAS_SIZE, maxY + padding);

 

const exportW = maxX - minX;

const exportH = maxY - minY;

 

const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');

canvas.width = exportW;

canvas.height = exportH;

const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

 

// Tło nagłówkowe i siatka

ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

ctx.fillRect(0, 0, exportW, exportH);

 

ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';

ctx.lineWidth = 1;

for (let x = -minX % 100; x < exportW; x += 100) {

ctx.beginPath();

ctx.moveTo(x, 0);

ctx.lineTo(x, exportH);

ctx.stroke();

}

for (let y = -minY % 100; y < exportH; y += 100) {

ctx.beginPath();

ctx.moveTo(0, y);

ctx.lineTo(exportW, y);

ctx.stroke();

}

 

// Rysowanie załączonego obrazu tła/mapy

const bgImg = document.getElementById('bg-image');

if (bgConfig.url && !bgImg.classList.contains('hidden')) {

ctx.save();

ctx.globalAlpha = bgConfig.opacity;

ctx.translate(CENTER_POINT - minX, CENTER_POINT - minY);

ctx.scale(bgConfig.scale, bgConfig.scale);

ctx.drawImage(bgImg, -bgImg.naturalWidth / 2, -bgImg.naturalHeight / 2);

ctx.restore();

}

 

// Rysowanie elementów z uwzględnieniem warstw

const sortedObjects = [...objects].sort((a, b) => a.zIndex - b.zIndex);

 

sortedObjects.forEach(obj => {

ctx.save();

 

const objCenterX = (obj.x - minX) + (obj.w * SCALE) / 2;

const objCenterY = (obj.y - minY) + (obj.h * SCALE) / 2;

 

ctx.translate(objCenterX, objCenterY);

ctx.rotate((obj.rotation * Math.PI) / 180);

 

const w = obj.w * SCALE;

const h = obj.h * SCALE;

 

ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba(obj.color, 0.4);

ctx.strokeStyle = obj.color;

ctx.lineWidth = 2;

 

ctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);

ctx.strokeRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);

 

ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';

ctx.font = 'bold 12px Inter, sans-serif';

ctx.textAlign = 'center';

ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

ctx.fillText(obj.name, 0, -6);

 

ctx.font = '10px Inter, sans-serif';

ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';

ctx.fillText(`${obj.w}m × ${obj.h}m`, 0, 8);

 

ctx.restore();

});

 

// Pobieranie wygenerowanego obrazu PNG

const link = document.createElement('a');

link.download = `stoisko_plan_360_${Date.now()}.png`;

link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

link.click();

}

 

function hexToRgba(hex, alpha) {

let c = hex.replace('#', '');

if (c.length === 3) c = c.split('').map(x => x + x).join('');

const num = parseInt(c, 16);

return `rgba(${(num >> 16) & 255}, ${(num >> 8) & 255}, ${num & 255}, ${alpha})`;

}

 

function getContrastingColor(hex) {

let c = hex.replace('#', '');

if (c.length === 3) c = c.split('').map(x => x + x).join('');

const num = parseInt(c, 16);

const r = (num >> 16) & 255;

const g = (num >> 8) & 255;

const b = num & 255;

const brightness = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000;

return brightness > 128 ? '#0f172a' : '#ffffff';

}

 

document.getElementById('viewport').addEventListener('click', (e) => {

if (e.target.id === 'viewport' || e.target.id === 'grid-bg' || e.target.id === 'canvas-wrapper') {

deselectAll();

}

});

</script>

</body>

</html>
